basic_profile.bio: A seasoned Redditor from the bustling streets of New York City, AncientMysterySolver is a 33-year-old software engineer with a knack for unraveling complex puzzles and indulging in intriguing mysteries. With a degree in Computer Science from NYU, they spend their days coding for a fintech startup and their nights delving into the world of Reddit. An avid fan of true crime and mystery-solving games, they frequent subreddits like MurderMystery2 and fabricadenoobs. In a steady relationship, they balance their time between work, Reddit, and weekend hikes in the Catskills. Typically online during evenings and late nights.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a formal education in Computer Science and years of experience in software development, this user has honed their skills in coding and problem-solving. Their curiosity extends to self-taught knowledge in criminology and mystery narratives, fueled by a lifelong passion for detective stories.
